note: Window agent m2600-m2501, repaired after review. events/0: the compiler's R2 (a successor wins from its own start year on) hands the 19 cells of Predynastic Ur back to the older collective sumerian-city-states (born -3400) in -2600, so first-dynasty-of-ur owned no land at all from -2600 to -2501, against its own keyframe first-dynasty-of-ur_-2600. The gain from the collective makes the dossier's city of Ur drawn (17 cells), as lagash is drawn over the collective from -2520. The 2 cells where Ur's 40 km circle overlaps Lagash's 40 km circle are cut from Ur so that Lagash's founding in -2520 keeps its full 19 cells. keyframe_overrides/0 (reaches into m2500-m2401, which does not override this keyframe): cells a patch hands to Ur before -2500 are no longer event-settled when Ur regains them in -2500, so without the override the collective's keyframe sumerian-city-states_-2500 would claim Ur's city again and R2 would give it back to the collective from -2500 on; the override cuts Ur's 40 km city from that keyframe.

region.text: the city of Ur in 'Predynastic Ur (c. 2600 – c. 2500 BC)', Early Dynastic IIIa; the 40 km circle is the dossier's, cut where it overlaps Lagash's own 40 km circle (2 cells), which stays Lagash's from -2520

events.note: 2600 BCE: the First Dynasty of Ur 'reigned c. 2600 – c. 2340 BC' with 'Predynastic Ur (c. 2600 – c. 2500 BC)' in the ruler table; the city is drawn from its founding over the collective's plain, as the dossier's keyframe first-dynasty-of-ur_-2600 says, and held until Mesannepada's keyframe in -2500.

correction.text: Sumer and Akkad without Mari, without Khuzestan and without the city of Ur, which is the First Dynasty of Ur's own (drawn from -2600 by data/patches/m2600-m2501.json: events/0)

keyframe_overrides.why: The dynasty 'reigned c. 2600 – c. 2340 BC' from Ur, Mesannepada 'r. c. 2500 BC'; the collective's -2500 shape must not claim Ur's own 40 km city, or R2 hands it back to the collective from -2500 on. Otherwise the dossier's own correction (without Mari and Khuzestan) is unchanged.
